dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This place feels... a little like the Ley Lines.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: That said, did these books come from? Couldn't have come from our library, could they?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Heh... Clearly the mages' handiwork — never ceases to impress, no matter how many times I see it.
